verified_failure_boundaries: Two threads and two processes with one expected revision produce one successful replacement and one conflict. Four append threads retain all 32 notes.
Real SIGKILL immediately before and after replacement preserves complete old/new heads, retained originals and subsequent OS lock acquisition.
Cancellation, oversized replacement, archive publication failure, damaged structured block, linked source and corrupt original are refused. Unknown revision never substitutes current bytes.
Tool read/write receipts expose source and raw-byte revision; successive same-second updates have distinct immutable checkpoint paths.
Native workflow references bind prior revision receipts. Missing expected revision is rejected at submission; a stale write does not retry, while independent work finishes with one worker.
Retention derives from current structured bytes despite a stale checkpoint and leaves the fresh corrected value active.
fixture_adjustments: Memory workflow fixtures explicitly name absence for their isolated new files; dependent updates bind the prior JSON Pointer revision.
The budget-pressure fixture waits for the persisted queued delay instead of the obsolete worker-held running state.

The mixed fairness fixture gives independent writes distinct source paths and keeps its deterministic probe runnable with delay_ms=0. Its original two-peer-task fairness assertion remains; three focused repeats and the final canonical native run passed.
preserved_boundaries: 4B answerer unchanged; no 9B substitution, dotenv credential read, TypeSafe call or live provider probe.
Production Agent-C daemon/gateway inactive and disabled; dedicated PostgreSQL exited restart=no.
GitHub only; Panda excluded. Private configuration, local instructions and pre-existing docs/PUBLISHING.md edits are outside these commits.
limitations: Linux process-crash tests do not qualify filesystem power loss, Windows runtime, MCU boot or physical-device execution.

The root-wide writer protocol covers cooperating memory API writers and structured producers; direct/in-place privileged edits, external deletion, directory replacement and daily-file rotation are outside its guarantee.
Hashes identify exact bytes, not a monotonic generation. Source identity depends on the configured canonical root and supplied relative path; root relocation changes it.
Pruning is bounded best effort, not a hard whole-store disk quota. Exact originals can be unavailable after retention; reads fail explicitly.

Current/historical/evidence eligibility across FTS/fallback/salience/injection, consistent multi-file retrieval, full source/revision/span bindings and correction/deletion invalidation remain the next milestone.
Publication verification does not establish retrieval recall, supported-answer accuracy, provider pricing, paid scorer quality or trusted evidence-presence completion.
